title: The interplay of DNA repair context with target sequence predictably biases Cas9-generated mutations
authors: Ananth Pallaseni, Elin Madli Peets, Gareth Girling, Luca Crepaldi, Ivan Kuzmin, Marilin Moor, Núria Muñoz-Subirana, Joost Schimmel, Özdemirhan Serçin, Balca R. Mardin, Marcel Tijsterman, Hedi Peterson, Michael Kosicki, Leopold Parts
relevance_to_cellguide: Large-scale (236,000+ mutational outcomes, 2,800+ synthetic targets, 18 repair-deficient mESC lines) mechanistic dissection of which DNA repair genes (Prkdc, Polm, Nbn, Polq) drive which mutation types. Relevant background for the plan's v2/v4 'repair outcome' and 'functional KO' stages — explains WHY repair outcome varies by genetic/cellular background, complementing SPROUT/Leenay (which the team couldn't source) and X-CRISP.
